timing: After screening began and before any matched control/treatment pair was launched.
reason: A protocol audit found that the v2 treatment ran the exact EnvBench evaluator online and returned evaluator-derived values while omitting raw bootstrap logs. This contradicted the preregistered Official-postepisode-only boundary.
unchanged: promotion, retention, kill, and insufficiency rules

implementation_replacement.arm_difference: Both arms expose the same submit_and_replay interface. The treatment executes the submitted complete program in a fresh target-state checkout and returns raw public-goal execution evidence; control returns the same typed shape with values withheld.
implementation_replacement.target_state: Spark EnvBench image, clean host-owned bind mount at /data/project, with a new checkout and container for each replay.
implementation_replacement.official_boundary: EnvBench Official is run unchanged only after each Agent episode and is never returned to that Agent.

scientific_effect: This is a pre-pair implementation correction required to make the mechanism conform to the original hypothesis and endpoint. It does not use treatment outcomes and does not alter case selection.
safeguard_note: This amendment is an evidence record, not a new runtime hash, frozen contract, or gate. Existing safety measures are unchanged.
